link.about: The link exchange (docs/protocol.md link_open and link_accept; docs/link-design.md 2). Seeds are the 32-byte Ed25519 seeds of the identity keys; secrets the 32-byte X25519 secrets; everything is lowercase hex of raw bytes except psk, which is the 64-character text Telesthete takes. 'valid': every value must come out exactly so, from either side. 'refused': each must be refused by the check it names.
